name: dms-hyprland-workspace-swapper
description: Dev tooling for the Hyprland Workspace Swapper DMS plugin; DMS itself never reads this file

scripts.reload: dms ipc call plugin-scan reload workspaceSwapper
scripts.test:hyprland: dms-testbed run hyprland --plugin . && dms-testbed ipc hyprland plugins enable workspaceSwapper && dms-testbed ipc hyprland workspace-swapper open
scripts.test:shot: mkdir -p screenshots; dms-testbed shot hyprland screenshots/hyprland.png
